### Summary

Minimal example

```toml
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0", "setuptools_scm[toml]>=6.2"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "test"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dynamic = ["version"]

[tool.uv]
no-build = true
```

Running `uv cache clean && uv lock -P test` results in 

>error: Failed to build `test @ file:///C:/Users/schlaich/Desktop/Temp/uv-build`
  cause: Building source distributions for `test` is disabled



### Platform

Windows 11

### Version

uv 0.12.19 (bea138450 2026-09-24 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)

### Python version

_No response_
title: no-build and dynamic version does not build first-party package
